title: An Improved Pseudopolynomial Time Algorithm for Subset Sum
authors: Lin Chen (Zhejiang University, China), Jiayi Lian (Zhejiang University, China), Yuchen Mao (Zhejiang University, China), Guochuan Zhang (Zhejiang University, China)
abstract: We investigate pseudo-polynomial time algorithms for Subset Sum. Given a multi-set $X$ of $n$ positive integers and a target $t$, Subset Sum asks whether some subset of $X$ sums to $t$. Bringmann proposes an $\widetilde{O}(n + t)$-time algorithm [Bringmann SODA'17], and an open question has naturally arisen: can Subset Sum be solved in $O(n + w)$ time? Here $w$ is the maximum integer in $X$. We make a progress towards resolving the open question by proposing an $\widetilde{O}(n + \sqrt{wt})$-time algorithm.
